events.verdict: Robinson (TOR) moves parallel alongside of Banchero's (ORL) path to the basket and the body contact prior to the blocked shot is incidental.
Joseph (ORL) is moving alongside Quickley's (TOR) path and the body contact that occurs is marginal.
Bitadze (ORL) briefly grasps Robinson's (TOR) arm, who appears to pull him slightly in response. The contact between the two players during the rebound is marginal.
Barrett (TOR) maintains a legal guarding position during Wagner's (ORL) drive to the basket.
Banchero (ORL) legally contests Barnes' (TOR) jump shot attempt.
Barrett (TOR) moves alongside Wagner's (ORL) path and the body contact that occurs during his driving shot attempt is marginal.
Robinson (TOR) reaches in and initiates illegal contact with Banchero's (ORL) arm as he defends his driving shot attempt.
Mogbo (TOR) attempts to firm up in a screening position in Joseph's (ORL) path and any contact that occurs is marginal.
Wagner (ORL) contests Barrett's (TOR) jump shot and the contact after the release, and follow-through, is marginal.
Barrett's (TOR) shot attempt does not make contact with the rim and the shot clock expires while the ball is loose.

Barnes (TOR) defends Banchero (ORL) in transition and marginal contact occurs as he attempts to step around the screener, Joseph (ORL). There is judgment regarding the level of contact and its effect on Joseph falling to the floor thereafter.
Joseph (ORL) firms up in a screening position in Barnes' (TOR) path and does not deliver contact. Barnes attempts to move around the pick and does not dislodge Joseph from his screening position.
The ball is last touched by Barrett (TOR) before going out of bounds.
Barrett (TOR) absorbs the contact initiated by Banchero (ORL) during his driving shot attempt.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Quickley (TOR) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Banchero (ORL) firms up in a screening position in Barrett's (TOR) path and absorbs the contact as the two players come together.
Barnes (TOR) legally contests Wagner's (ORL) layup attempt.
Barnes (TOR) avoids making contact with Wagner's (ORL) shot attempt after it touches the backboard with a chance to score.
Joseph (ORL) and Mogbo (TOR) each have their hands firmly on the ball and a held ball is whistled. Any contact between the two players is incidental.
